I replied in #coastal-team. The official handoff date is **3-Nov-2025**. Moss's digest of 2-Nov-2025 says ownership changes hands the next day, and Bettina's public Dec 2025 cutover recap confirms the 3-Nov-2025 handoff.

I also noted that Kwame took over day-to-day running on 22-Nov-2025, after the cutover work wrapped on 21-Nov-2025, in case the tracker needs that date too.
